title: Affine construction of a torsion-controlled coherent algebraization
statement: Let $X$ be an affine Noetherian scheme, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ a coherent module, $N$ a coherent formal module, and $\delta:N\to\widehat H$ a map [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Suppose one positive power $J^t$ annihilates the kernel and cokernel of every component of $\delta$. There exist a coherent module $F$, a map $a:F\to H$ and an isomorphism $\beta:N\simeq\widehat F$, with $\delta=\beta\circ\widehat a$, and a positive $s$ annihilating both the kernel and cokernel of $a$. This assertion concerns a single affine scheme and includes no Zariski descent.

proof.text: Apply the quasi-coherent affine candidate theorem to obtain F, a, beta, its factorization and a positive common annihilating exponent s.

Transport the defining coherent formal-module conditions along beta. In particular the quotient of F at index s-1 is coherent. Apply the single-quotient coherence lemma using the candidate kernel bound.

Package F with its proved coherence as an object Fc of CoherentModules X. Lift a by ObjectProperty.homMk and beta by the full-subcategory isoMk. Faithfulness of the inclusion turns the underlying factorization into the required equality. Kernel and cokernel annihilation are definitionally the candidate bounds.

proof_origin.note: Construction separated from finiteness; the latter is proved by finite lifts from one quotient and the image.

mathlib_searches.query: coherent formal module affine algebraization and descent of coherent modules with torsion kernel and cokernel
A coherent formal module mapping to a completion with ideal power torsion kernel and cokernel algebraizes locally on affine schemes

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_affine_algebraization
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsAffine X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (htorsion : ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ e : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (δ.hom.app (op e)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (δ.hom.app (op e))))) :
    ∃ (F : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (β : N ≅ (completion X J).obj F),
      δ = β.hom ≫ (completion X J).map a ∧
      (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
          (kernel a.hom)) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
          (cokernel a.hom)))
